description: Payment-safety verdict: is it safe to accept or pay this token right now? Returns SAFE, CAUTION, or DO_NOT_ACCEPT with safe_to_accept / safe_to_pay booleans and reasons, judged on the live peg price per request ($0.01 USDC per call). USYC is always CAUTION: it is a yield-bearing fund share, not a dollar. Every paid verdict also carries an OFAC sanctions screen and an Ed25519 attestation over the verdict. Add counterparty (the address you are about to pay) to screen it against the OFAC SDN list; a hit blocks the payment. First call (no payment_signature) returns the payment challenge; pay the exact USDC on Solana, then call again with payment_signature.

counterparty.description: Address you are about to pay (EVM 0x + 40 hex, or base58 32-44 chars). Screened against the OFAC SDN list.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Omit on the first call to receive the payment challenge. After sending the exact USDC amount on Solana mainnet to the pay_to wallet, call again with this set to the Solana transaction signature of your payment.

token.description: One of: usyc, usdt, usdc, usde, dai

name: check_payment_safety
